business_summary: Guangdong Prolto Supply Chain Management Co., Ltd. provides supply chain management solutions and new energy services in China and internationally. It operates a global delivery platform; a medical service platform; and a B2B service platform in line with customer needs in the ICT field. It also offers financial leasing services; and cross-border e-commerce service solutions with import and export product trade, logistics clearance, brand agency and promotion, and supply chain finance and other cross-border e-commerce integrated solutions. It provides international and domestic freight forwarding services; information consulting; asset management; professional contracting for mechanical and electrical equipment installation projects; mechanical and electrical equipment installation services; and liquid and air-cooled energy storage power station systems, and small liquid-cooled energy units. It is also involved in the investment and operation of industrial and commercial energy storage power station projects; investment and operation of independent energy storage power stations; sales of automobiles; wholesale and retail of steel; wholesale of building materials and decorative materials, and metal products; and sales of computer software and hardware, communication products, electronic products, electronic components, integrated circuits, and household appliances. In addition, it engages in the production and operation of medical devices; food circulation, including packaged foods and health foods; wholesale of agricultural and sideline products, and pre-packaged foods; sells nickel sulfide, nickel hydroxide, and cobalt hydroxide; commission agency; and special equipment repair. Further, it is involved in the investment, construction, and operation of distributed photovoltaic projects, electricity market-based trading, and comprehensive energy services. Guangdong Prolto Supply Chain Management Co., Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
